NOTE: this pipeline calls google-reviews-intelligence, yelp-review-intelligence, trustpilot-brand-reputation, and g2-reviews-scraper, whose own review_extracted charges also bill the buyer in addition to these per-profile events. Document combined cost in README.

single_source.eventDescription: One brand profiled from a single platform. Includes the platform rating, sampled mean, recent vs overall trend, negative share, and the top complaint and praise themes from the review text.

profile.eventDescription: One brand profiled across two platforms. Adds the volume-weighted reputation score 0-100 and the rating gap between platforms, the tell for review-gaming or a channel mismatch.

deep_profile.eventDescription: One brand profiled across three or more platforms. The fullest reputation read: weighted score, divergence flag, recent trend, and pooled complaint and praise themes across every platform. The first profile of this tier per run is free so you can validate the output.
